merchant_applications_status_coherence_c.name: merchant_applications_status_coherence_check
merchant_applications_status_coherence_c.value:
(
        ("merchant_applications"."status" = 'PENDING'
          AND "merchant_applications"."merchant_id" IS NULL
          AND "merchant_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NULL
          AND "merchant_applications"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NULL
          AND length(btrim("merchant_applications"."rejection_reason")) = 0)
        OR ("merchant_applications"."status" = 'APPROVED'
          AND "merchant_applications"."merchant_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "merchant_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "merchant_applications"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(btrim("merchant_applications"."rejection_reason")) = 0)
        OR ("merchant_applications"."status" = 'REJECTED'
          AND "merchant_applications"."merchant_id" IS NULL
          AND "merchant_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "merchant_applications"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

order_events_from_status_check.name: order_events_from_status_check
order_events_from_status_check.value: from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELED')

orders_canceled_by_check.name: orders_canceled_by_check
orders_canceled_by_check.value: canceled_by IS NULL OR canceled_by IN ('CUSTOMER', 'MERCHANT_USER', 'ADMIN', 'SYSTEM')

orders_cancel_reason_check.name: orders_cancel_reason_check
orders_cancel_reason_check.value: cancel_reason IS NULL OR cancel_reason IN ('CUSTOMER_REQUEST', 'MERCHANT_UNAVAILABLE', 'OUT_OF_STOCK', 'PAYMENT_ISSUE', 'OTHER')
